name: @storytree/dev-loop
description: Mick's dev loop (story_95ed402f9bd3, ADR-0805 D3, ADR-1170 D3): the personal half of the dev loop, around the base dev loop's gate runner (packages/base-dev-loop): the test runner and its scoping, storytree's gate (its lock, worktree install and seven contributed checks), worktree provisioning, the guidance build, the library's export, restore and server, the recording of a test run (moved from CI health, which keeps the verdict rules and the verified-column writer it reaches), configured for storytree as its own health (ADR-1066 D2 G), and storytree's declarations for the Guardrails story's package and allocation checks. The root package.json's commands and CI run them from here.
